coarse_reuse_audit.recorded_checks: 48 global initial residuals >1e-7 and final residuals <1e-9 across two stages (per the bound audit); do not substitute its old runtime tolerance for the PR309 1e-9 runs.
coarse_reuse_audit.scope: existing h=.9375, 15 s run only; reuse counterfactual audit, not a PR309 60 s result

criteria.if_all_six_pass_60: stop at 60 s; no automatic horizon extension
criteria.if_any_field_fails_60: record failure and diagnostics; stop at 60 s; no automatic horizon extension
criteria.meaning: single named-case budget screen only; no project-wide target, accuracy bound, or reference qualification
criteria.metric: At t=60 s, compare fine-minus-coarse in the official V3 published NetCDF fields: each FP32 field is promoted to FP64 before subtraction/RMS, apply the fixed V3 physical-owner masks, and compare RMS to the unchanged epsilon/3 reference-check limit per field. This is a resolution-pair screen, not truth, order, or global-error evidence.

MU.units: total dry column mass MU+MUB in Pa; all mass points

PH.units: m^2/s^2 geopotential; PH perturbation, fixed lower face excluded, top included

T.units: physical potential temperature T+300 K; all mass points

U.units: m/s; unique periodic X faces only

V.units: m/s; both physical Y walls included

criteria.source: committed named-case V3 fixed budget contract; budget values unchanged

decision_policy.all_outcomes: Regardless of whether any/all six fields pass, stop all work at 60 s. No automatic or discretionary 120/240 s extension and no additional model runs under this protocol.
decision_policy.at_60s_all_six_pass: record only that the named paired case passes the frozen V3 epsilon/3 resolution screen; stop all planned work at 60 s
decision_policy.at_60s_any_field_fails: record the named screen failure and observed diagnostics; stop all planned work at 60 s
decision_policy.scope: The six-field screen is the frozen named-case resolution check only; neither outcome establishes true error, convergence order, forecast acceptance, or a project-wide criterion.

forbidden_inferences: accuracy acceptance beyond the single frozen t60 V3 screen

outputs.primary: compact NPZ of 65/129 physical W endpoints, raw/projected W endpoints, fixed M0/e1, selected interval step summaries
secondary: JSON binding hashes, receipts, all summaries, endpoint and initial-state gates

pair.initial_state: all six packed state vectors must be exact equal between runs; separately require all eight published NetCDF initial fields bitwise equal and finite
pair.time_join: accepted CSV logical step_seq with exact rational elapsed time; coarse j matches fine 2j; NetCDF Times only endpoint checks at t=0 and t=60

per_step_operator_audit.interpretation: local increment bound does not propagate through later nonlinear stage maps and is not a trajectory error bound
per_step_operator_audit.source: each actual current-run accepted_ark_w_step_N.csv via tools/analyze_accepted_ark_w_stage.py; never substitute PR308 h15 values for per-step quantities
summary: G_W RMS/max for implicit stages 2-4; stage1 G N/A
K-FI_RK RMS/max per stage and local direct increment bound h*sum_(implicit i=2..4)|b_i|*RMS_W(K-FI_RK)
measured/source-derived-top pressure and buoyancy stage powers and tableau work

physical_w_trajectory.publication: Official t=60 six-field V3 screen uses FP32 NetCDF outputs promoted to FP64. Internal FP64 accepted-step W trajectory remains a separate 65-point diagnostic; t=0/t=60 internal-to-publication roundtrip is reported independently.
physical_w_trajectory.raw_layout: accepted trace packed U,V,W,PH,T,MU; internal W crop [j=0:16,kface=1:17,i=0:16] then transpose to physical [k,j,i]
physical_w_trajectory.store_endpoints: initial input plus every projected_final FP64 W endpoint; retain raw_final W endpoints separately

producer_lineage.source_pin_check: The canonical preflight source_checks all pass; do not conflate build-receipt HEAD with committed observer source snapshot.

scope: one existing-source, existing-executable paired 0-60 s W trajectory at h=.9375/.46875 with Newton tolerance 1e-9; offline analysis only

six_field_t60.interpretation: Arithmetic screen for this paired refinement only; passing does not establish accuracy or truth.

owner_masks.PH: drop fixed lower z face; retain top
owner_masks.W: drop fixed lower z face; retain dynamic top

physical_transform_before_comparison.MU: MU + MUB Pa (total dry column mass)

six_field_t60.precision_and_source: Published WRF NetCDF endpoint values (FP32) are read with the repository-owned tools/benchmark_wrf_accuracy_cost.py::_load_run path, promoted to FP64, then differenced and scored. Do not substitute internal packed FP64 state for this official V3 screen.

status: frozen_before_pr309_native_outputs; v3 is final pre-run protocol

V1 had incorrectly described an internal-FP64-only endpoint screen for five fields and a separate W publication check.

supersedes_v2.reason: Final pre-run closure: all possible outcomes stop at 60 s; bind canonical preflight and the existing coarse 15 s reuse audit. No screen values changed.

trajectory_diagnostic.detail_interval: first common endpoint j>0 where W RMS exceeds the unchanged epsilon_W/3 selects [t_(j-1),t_j]; if no crossing, use fixed final interval [59.0625,60] s
